_about: Bike lanes (engine/fetch_bikes.py, engine/bikes.py): the City of Vancouver's Bikeways (OGL – Vancouver), active segments only. Each segment's bikeway_type puts it in one of the layer's classes; types not listed here are left out and printed by the build. The seawall and other off-street paths are 'Off-Street Path' segments in the same file.
